confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors use Montevideo cost-of-living averages, which vary between snapshots, especially for a mid-range meal. Cocktail and wine prices are bounded estimates based on their local price relationship to beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; food anchors are based on Montevideo price data, and accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of this high-cost Southern Cone capital.
